'''August 2000 Las Vegas tournament (26 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Las Vegas, NV on 26 August 2000. [[Matt Berta]] won it. It is known from Danny Rider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1175">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-29-las-vegas-nv-8-26-00d1175/ las-vegas-nv-8-26-00], DeckTech (Danny "Skuff D" Rider, 29 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-29-las-vegas-nv-8-26-00d1175/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas, NV
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Berta]]
